effect_description_eng: ＜Collision＞ ＜Reboot＞ ＜Blocker＞ [All Turns] When this Digimon would leave the battle area, by returning 1 of your other Digimon or 1 [Gankoomon] or [X Antibody] from this Digimon's digivolution cards to the bottom of the deck, it doesn't leave. [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any of your Digimon leave the battle area, you may activate 1 [Main] effect on this card's Option side.

option.effect_text: ＜Use Req. ([Huckmon] in text)＞ (Specified conditions meet color requirements.) [Main] Return 1 of your opponent's 12000 DP or higher Digimon to the top of the deck. If this effect didn't return, delete 1 of your opponent's lowest play cost Digimon.
